ModMetaData.name: Raid Check
ModMetaData.author: pengin0503
ModMetaData.description:
On-demand raid composition examples for RimWorld 1.7. Includes alternative strategies and arrivals. No background raid calculations. Preview build: actual game UI and native algorithms have not yet been runtime-tested.
RimWorld 1.7用の手動襲撃編成チェック。通常襲撃・工兵・破壊・包囲・降下などに対応。定期計算なし。実ゲーム未検証のプレビュー版です。
